segments.title: Pepito Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on as a dog, imposes scroll tariffs, and manages early technical difficulties with alerts.

segments.title: Fake Drake Call-In Bit
segments.notes: Case attempts to patch in a Drake impersonator for a celebrity call-in; the fake Drake rambles about Canada, syrup, mental struggles, and declares a presidential run.

segments.title: Noam Chomsky Death Hoax & Peter Gibbon Wall Escape
segments.notes: Case investigates conflicting reports of Chomsky's death; Peter Gibbon interrupts from the walls, claims squatter's rights under a 'wall amendment,' and is eventually banished back for a month.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Trailers Catch-Up
segments.notes: Trent screens Metroid Prime 4, Smile 2, Condor Man (1981), A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead game, and Fear of a Black Hat trailers; Case and Trent debate hat styles and practical effects.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple: Armie Hammer Breaks Silence
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple reviews Armie Hammer's Access Hollywood interview addressing cannibal texts, abuse allegations, and comeback attempts; Case and Ripple debate forgiveness and Hollywood redemption.

segments.title: Big Mac Taco, Latte Art, Paper Airplane & High Notes
segments.notes: Jeb demonstrates a Big Mac taco recipe, latte art tutorial, a 60-second paper airplane (which Case fails to replicate), and vocal coaching for high notes; Jeb's Dad's board interjects; AI-generated 'Jeff is the Wood' song debuts.

segments.title: Conspiracy Time: Blueberry Conspiracy & Smurf Interview
segments.notes: Guy Redacted investigates whether blueberries are actually blue/good; deep-dive into colloidal silver turning a man blue, Randy's anti-blue-food rant, and a live interview with a self-identified Smurf who reveals Smurf biology, Mr. Pibb transmutation, and anarcho-monogamous society.

segments.title: Debate: Is Armie Hammer a Cannibal? + Poll Chaos
segments.notes: Munch defends Hammer as a sexually gifted deviant; Crum argues he's a terrible guy on an apology tour; poll graphics glitch, scores tie at 100, Munch claims moral victory; Case hires Munch for a 'mini peace task force.'

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Elden Ring Transition Attempt
segments.notes: Pepito returns cheesed-out; Case checks on Kendall, then attempts to switch to Elden Ring setup for Shadow of the Erdtree prep while Drake lingers on the line.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News investigates the Noam Chomsky death hoax while fending off a wall escape by Peter Gibbon, then pivots to a trailer catch-up featuring Condor Man and Metroid Prime 4. Jeff Ripple dissects Armie Hammer's cannibal-text redemption tour, Jeb Nogget serves up a Big Mac taco and a paper airplane disaster, and new conspiracy correspondent Guy Redacted uncovers a Smurf-led anarcho-monogamous society beneath the blueberry discourse. The broadcast closes with a glitched Munch & Crum debate on Hammer's guilt, a tied 100-100 score, and Case's abortive attempt to switch to Elden Ring for DLC prep.
